purpose: Stage 3 of the screen (investment intensity) for members and candidates. Context beside each company; it does not decide membership, which is decided by filed evidence.

method.tests: A company passes if any one test is at or above the median of the companies screened here: three-year revenue CAGR (FY23 to FY26, total revenue to total revenue), capex growth (FY26 vs FY25), capex to sales (FY26, revenue from operations), R&D to sales (FY26, where disclosed).
method.medians: Medians are of the members and candidates screened here, a group already selected for AI-infrastructure exposure, not of the NSE universe. Below the median means less intensive than these peers, not that a company is not investing.
method.missing: A figure that could not be read is null. A company with no figure for a test is not tested on it; a company with no figures at all is not screened. Neither counts as a fail.

sources.revenue: Trendlyne structured data: Operating Rev. Ann. (FY26), Total Rev. Ann. (FY26), Rev. Ann. 3Y ago (FY23, total revenue). Total FY26 was checked to equal operating revenue plus other income for every company used.
sources.capex: Each company's FY2025-26 cash flow statement, investing activities, the purchase of property, plant and equipment line; read via Trendlyne document search, with the excerpt recorded per company. POWERINDIA and CLEANMAX are AGI's own primary reads.
sources.rnd: Board's report technology-absorption annexure or the R&D note, where disclosed. A stated nil is 0; an undisclosed figure is null. Usually a standalone (company-level) figure.
